## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The retry cap must be corrected before merge because the helper exceeds the governing five-attempt limit.

## Changes
The pull request adds a retrying fetch helper with a ten-attempt default, retry tests, and a review fixture. It also proposes raising the documented retry cap to ten.

## Critical
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Enforce the five-attempt retry cap — When an upstream consistently raises OSError, the default call makes ten attempts. This violates “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” (`AGENTS.md:5`). — During upstream outages, callers generate twice the permitted request load and prolong failure handling. — Fix: Update the default, validation, docstring, and cap tests together to enforce at most five attempts.
